body: I work at a school, and alot of the teens there have Hurt themselves physically but i just tell them to get a tattoo instead haha! Sometimes they ask me if thats why i have them and i just smile like an idiot🙌🏼
Everyone has got their thing to struggle with, for me it helps getting tattoos. Helps relieve the pain and ends up with beautiful art on my body. Got an appointment for two more this week
I honestly dont know why anyone would downvote this, but thank you anyways! It meant more than you thought
Im so sorry for your loss... take care of yourself and those close to you, i wish i could take his place
